pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark-brown regions exhibiting complex, non-smooth edge gradients with sharp angular protrusions. Patch area is significantly greater than the surrounding corridor area, with elongated geometries appearing toward the lower neck region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of off-white pathways forming a contiguous grid. Junctions consist of 3-way and 4-way nodes with relatively uniform pixel width across the visible field, creating a high-contrast lattice between dark patches.
